description: Pokémon Emerald (Gen-3, GBA). Same control surface as Ruby/Sapphire; own id so the translation layer (walk_grid navigation, screen rules, keyboard layout) keys correctly.

confirm.hint: Advance dialog one box. Talk to NPC facing you. Pick up item on the tile in front. Confirm a menu choice. The single most-used button.

cancel.hint: Cancel / back out / close menu. Hold while walking to run (after the Running Shoes are obtained from Mom).

menu.hint: Open the main menu: Pokédex, Pokémon, Bag, Player, Save, Option, Exit. Only available in the overworld.

registered.hint: Use the currently registered key item. Common registrations: Bike (toggles riding), Itemfinder.

nav_up.hint: Walk one tile north. First press while facing another direction just turns you to face north (no movement). Held: continuous walking.

nav_down.hint: Walk one tile south. First press while facing another direction just turns you to face south. Held: continuous walking.

nav_left.hint: Walk one tile west. First press while facing another direction just turns you to face west. Held: continuous walking.

nav_right.hint: Walk one tile east. First press while facing another direction just turns you to face east. Held: continuous walking.

notes: Emerald does not bind L/R in the overworld. Exposed as hardware passthrough so a power user (or future rule) can still drive them directly.
